name: sawbuck-reins
description: Prove each green was earned in the source, not by editing the test; keep what git threw away and show it when a file comes up again; write down the rules you keep telling your agent. One install: /sawbuck-reins:rules (propose the rules you keep enforcing), /sawbuck-reins:shape (what you push on, and what the agent does that you never push on), /sawbuck-reins:audit (find rules that pull against each other), /sawbuck-reins:contract (give the repo its rules and watch every turn), /sawbuck-reins:check (try it now), /sawbuck-reins:status (what it caught, the debt, what you keep saying), and the guide band (watching / N caught / last verdict / steer rate). The mod itself runs no program.

judge.title: Live steering judge
judge.description: On by default: one call per turn through Claude Code's own model API, on your plan, to show how much you steer. The model is yours to pick below. Type native or off: off stops it. /sawbuck-reins:rules and /sawbuck-reins:shape work either way.

judgeModel.title: Steering judge model
judgeModel.description: Which model scores your turns for the steering readout. Type sonnet, haiku or opus. Sonnet is the default: it agreed with a careful reading of 200 real turns at kappa 0.66, Haiku at 0.41 (cheaper, noisier). Opus costs the most.

band.title: Guide band
band.description: Show the guide band above your prompt. Type on or off. Set it to off if you show sawbuck in your own statusline instead (sawbuck statusline, below the prompt), so it does not appear twice.
